ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a square window, inside there are several line segments connecting from the same interior point to the boundary of the square, dividing the square into six triangles; this interior intersection point is the position where the fly is located. The uppermost region is a triangle, its base is exactly the entire upper side of the square, and the third vertex is the intersection point where the fly is located. Reasoning: The area of the square is 81 cm^2, so the side length is 9 cm. The six triangles have equal areas, therefore the area of each triangle is 81/6 = 13.5 cm^2. Take the uppermost triangle, its base is 9 cm, and its height is the perpendicular distance from the fly to the upper side of the square. Let this distance be h, then (1/2)·9·h = 13.5, solving gives h = 3 cm. So the fly is at a distance of 3 cm from the top. The total height of the square is 9 cm, therefore the fly's distance from the bottom is 9 - 3 = 6 cm.

raw_record.question_text: A vertical stained glass square window of area $81 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$ is made out of six triangles of equal area (see figure). A fly is sitting on the exact spot where the six triangles meet. How far from the bottom of the window is the fly sitting?

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the square window is partitioned by line segments meeting at the fly, and the top region is a single triangle whose base is the entire top side of the square and whose third vertex is the fly. From the text, the square has area 81 cm^2, so its side length is 9 cm, and the six triangles have equal area, so each triangle has area 81/6 = 13.5 cm^2. Use the top triangle: its base is 9 cm and its height is the vertical distance from the fly to the top of the square. Solve (1/2)(9)(top distance) = 13.5 to get the fly is 3 cm below the top. Therefore its distance from the bottom is 9 - 3 = 6 cm.

图像描述：图中是一个正方形窗户，内部有若干线段从同一个内部点向正方形边界连接，把正方形分成六个三角形；这个内部交点就是苍蝇所在位置。最上方的区域是一个三角形，它的底边正好是整个正方形的上边，第三个顶点是苍蝇所在的交点。

推理：正方形面积为 81 cm^2，所以边长为 9 cm。六个三角形面积相等，因此每个三角形面积为 81/6 = 13.5 cm^2。取最上方三角形，它的底为 9 cm，高就是苍蝇到正方形上边的垂直距离。设该距离为 h，则 (1/2)·9·h = 13.5，解得 h = 3 cm。所以苍蝇在距离顶部 3 cm 处。正方形总高为 9 cm，因此苍蝇距离底部为 9 - 3 = 6 cm。
